notes: PARTIAL (ll. 1-5 only). Read sign by sign from Griffith's printed cursive type, right to left. FHN confirms REM 0400+N for Meroe nos. 2, 5, 7, 8-10, 12, 15, 18, 19 and 30 (REM 0430 = no. 30's 'Wosi Msmni' table), so this text is probably REM 0444, but no source seen gives it.
